arm: lodo_carm (trained on COBRA Elekta + DeepFluoro real frames, C-ArmLSpine never seen; best.pt selected on those devices' test splits, not on C-ArmLSpine)
matching: greedy one-to-one in descending confidence, IoU >= 0.5 (body / outline truth) or mutual centre containment (centre)
cluster: case (28; each case contributes an AP and a lateral frame)

conf_0.25_as_quoted.how_chosen: the YOLO predict default; the value tools/or_lodo_rescore_outline.py printed and docs/RSNAI_CLAIMS.json quoted; not chosen on any data, not pre-stated with a rationale

cross_device_0.74.how_chosen: best pooled vertebra F1 of THIS arm on its OTHER-device sweeps (COBRA Elekta, DeepFluoro, Geneva), read from curves.json cells/lodo_carm/carm_test/cross_device_threshold: chosen before looking at the C-ArmLSpine test, so a pre-deployment operating point

own_best_f1_outline_0.60.how_chosen: best outline-convention F1 on THIS test set: test-tuned, optimistic, reported only as a bound

shipped_curves_json_note.note: curves.json scores against the BODY truth (realxray_eval), under which this arm's vertebra recall reads 5 % by convention mismatch; its sacrum interval is reproduced here under 'sacrum_found_body'

headline.label: held-out vertebra recall, outline truth, conf 0.25 (as quoted)
